insurer: The New India Assurance Co. Ltd.

room_rent.note: Policy covers room rent as part of hospitalisation expenses; no explicit cap or sub-limit stated in wording. SI is only ₹5,000 per person.

icu.note: ICU defined but no separate cap mentioned; covered under hospitalisation expenses.

copayment.note: No co-payment clause found in the policy wording.

sub_limits.note: No disease-wise or procedure-wise sub-limits mentioned beyond the overall SI of ₹5,000 per person.

deductible.note: No deductible clause applicable to this policy.

initial_waiting.note: Standard 30-day waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: Pre-existing diseases excluded for 36 months from first policy inception; no optional reduction mentioned.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12-month wait for cataract, hernia, hydrocele, BPH, hysterectomy, fistula, piles, sinusitis, congenital internal diseases. 90-day wait for diabetes, hypertension, cardiac conditions. 36-month wait for mental illness, ARMD, genetic disorders, external congenital diseases.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Excl18; only ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.note: No cumulative/no-claim bonus mentioned in the policy wording.

restoration.note: No restoration or reset benefit mentioned in the policy wording.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 30 days prior to admission.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation medical expenses covered for 60 days after discharge.

day_care.note: Day-care treatment covered for procedures requiring less than 24 hours due to technological advancement; specific listed procedures (dialysis, chemotherapy, eye surgery, etc.) explicitly included.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered but excludes 12 specific conditions including asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, psychiatric disorders, etc.

ayush.note: AYUSH inpatient treatment covered up to 100% of Sum Insured per policy year.

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in the policy wording.

ambulance.note: Ambulance is listed under List I (items not covered). Ambulance equipment also excluded.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed including robotic surgery, stereotactic radio surgery, oral chemotherapy, intravitreal injections, stem cell therapy (haematological), etc., covered as inpatient or day care.

consumables.note: Consumables such as gloves, masks, nebuliser kits, etc. are listed under non-payable items (List I). Consumables cost is listed as a coverage head (3.1C) but standard non-medical consumables are excluded via Annexure I.

global_cover.note: Treatment outside geographical limits of India is explicitly excluded (clause 4.4.27).

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months, no claim contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: Grace period is 15 days for monthly premium mode and 30 days for all other modes.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from date of receipt of policy document; applicable to new policies of 1 year or more.

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted as per IRDAI guidelines with continuity of waiting period credits.

notable_exclusions.display: Maternity, ambulance, dental (non-accident), external prosthetics, acupuncture, vaccination, overseas treatment, war, NBC weapons, RFQMR/ECP/EECP/hyperbaric oxygen

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-on covers described in the policy wording.
